architecture.summary: Default path is Blocks, IPFS, alx.index, and alx.registry with zero ALX anchor writes. Optional rare ALXAnchor commits (blockHash or blockset) for public existence-time. Legacy ALXRegistry pointer reads only.

alxAnchor.role: blockHash and blockset existence-time on Base
alxAnchor.note: Set address after Sepolia deployment. Promote to base-mainnet after review.

pointerRegistry.role: blockHash to IPFS CID (or storage pointer) for trustless resolve

checkpointRegistry.role: Merkle checkpoint roots and inclusion proofs over blockHash leaves
checkpointRegistry.note: Reference-only. Merkle proofs stay off-chain in the SDK; do not deploy for new integrations.

platformRegistry.role: Multi-vendor platform owners and attestors (marketplace governance)
platformRegistry.note: Reference-only. Use alx.index off-chain for platform approval; not required for new work.

canonicalRegistryBlock.description: Informative ALX catalog blockHash — update when publishing a new alx.registry Block
